name: Ano Mura ni wa Onna no Ko ga Hitori Shika Inai
original_name: あの村には女の子が一人しかいない
source:
Seeking her long-separated father, a young girl named Yukie enters a village of men.
Men who, in the secluded backcountry of the mountains, will do bad things to her.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE187342.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
为了寻找失散已久的父亲，一位名叫由纪惠的年轻女孩进入了一个男人村。
那些在深山僻静的地方，会对她做坏事的男人。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE187342.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
